rachats.nom: Crown London (ex Crown London Aspinalls, rebaptise Wynn Mayfair)
rachats.citation: "In January 2025, Wynn Resorts completed the acquisition of the Crown London casino, formerly owned by Crown Resorts. It was rebranded as Wynn Mayfair."

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
